# AZ Restaurant Partners

> We run your front of house. Same sales, a fraction of the payroll.
>
> Phone, tables, counter, website and guest texts, run as one system: it takes every order, gets it
> paid before it cooks, and brings guests back. We set it up in your restaurant and run it with you.
>
> The difference: phone AI companies (Slang, Maple, Loman) answer one line. AZ takes over the front of
> house: phone, tables, counter, website, texts to guests and the owner's phone, on one menu and one
> guest list. Built and proven in our own restaurant in Houston. Set up in person in Houston. We earn
> when you get orders. Haniya is our AI host, one member of the front-of-house team; each restaurant
> can have its own host.
>
> Proof, from our own restaurant in Houston (Clover data, Jul 26 - Oct 23 2026): staff-taken orders
> went from 297 a month (August) to none (October), and sales held steady while it happened. 100% of
> guest orders are placed by the guest. Every call is answered, even after we close. Nothing is cooked
> until it is paid.
>
> Founded by Abbas Zoeb, a former Google software engineer who worked on Hard Rock Cafe's first AI
> agents and built this for his family's restaurant. Seen on FOX 26 and KPRC 2 Houston.
>
> Serving Spring, The Woodlands, greater Houston and across Texas and the US.
>
> Terms: no setup fee, no contract, and for the first two months
> you only cover what the technology costs to run. After that, we earn only on orders we bring you, and you keep what we build. Free demo on your own menu.

## What AZ does (offerings)
- Commission Rescue — move orders off the ~30% third-party delivery apps to first-party ordering.
- AI Phone Agent — answer every call 24/7, take orders into the POS, book tables, handle catering.
- Get found by AI & Google — AEO/SEO so AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) and search recommend the restaurant.
- More 5-star reviews — solicit happy guests, intercept unhappy ones before they post.
- Win back regulars — loyalty, consent-based SMS, and a guest list the owner owns.
- Catering & corporate lunches — a real off-premise channel at higher margins.
- End the tablet chaos — delivery apps consolidated into one POS/kitchen.
- See your numbers — one clear dashboard of sales, labor, and food cost across locations.
- Custom engineering — when no existing tool fits, AZ builds the software (or the non-software play) the restaurant uniquely needs.
